scenes.hook: Responsive Web Design. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Responsive design adapts a page to different screen sizes. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Use flexible layouts so content can rearrange as space changes.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: Responsive images and a viewport declaration support mobile layouts. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Test real content at narrow widths instead of targeting only one device.
scenes.try: Make a card layout that works on a phone and desktop. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
